statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The 22:00Z futures restart that was the prior run's mapped danger window has now been observed and it was orderly, so Tail sits near its floor while Stress stays elevated on an unresolved crude supply premium.
recommendation: Path risk across this window is concentrated in the 13:30Z-14:30Z US cash reopen, the first full-depth session after the three-day weekend. Outside that window the mapped state remains green with Tail well below the block threshold.
headline: The Labor Day halt has ended without incident: NQ restarted at +0.08% with no gap, and the mapped danger window moves forward to Tuesday's 13:30Z cash reopen
body: CME equity-index futures resumed matching at 22:00Z for the Tuesday trade date after a halt that began at 17:00Z, and the restart is the single most important new observation of this run. NQ prints 29,587.50, up 22.25 points (+0.08%) against the 29,565.25 pre-halt level, and an independent quote corroborates it at 29,582.50, up 17.25 (+0.06%), on a single-print range at 18:13:46 ET. There is no gap and no discontinuity. The prior run mapped this hour to WATCH on the reasoning that roughly five hours of unpriced escalation would meet the thinnest liquidity of the week; that hypothetical did not materialise, and because the observed path is now the evidence rather than the forecast, Tail returns to 9. ES is the one mild counter-signal at 7,708.25, down 13.75 (-0.18%) on a 7,703.75-7,728.50 range from a 7,715.50 open. NQ up against ES down is a conflicting cross-check, which under the standing framework raises uncertainty rather than Tail. The energy channel did carry into the restart. WTI October trades at 92.64, up 1.16 (+1.27%) on a 90.87-93.29 range, above Monday's 91.48 settle, and Brent is near 97.28 (+0.69%). Reuters reported Brent up 0.9% at 97.13 with a six-week high of 98.06 and WTI up 1.3% at 92.63, both the highest since 24 July, after Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery was attacked on Monday with damage still being assessed. The US struck three Iranian oil tankers on Saturday and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it struck three tankers and three US-linked vessels; Kpler counts roughly ten commodity ships a day transiting the Strait of Hormuz over the past ten days, the lowest since May. Against that, the demand and inventory side remains a genuine offset: the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve has fallen below 290 million barrels, its lowest since 1982, and China has cut crude imports and refinery runs. That balance is why Stress holds at 62 rather than extending. The macro channel is separate and unresolved. August payrolls came in at 162,000 against roughly 53,000 to 56,000 expected with unemployment at 4.1%, lifting FedWatch odds of a 25 basis point increase at the 15-16 September meeting to about 58-60% and pushing the two-year yield to its highest since January 2025. The US bond market was closed on Monday, so the most recent H.15 values remain those for 3 September, 4.34% at two years and 4.77% at ten. VIX last traded at 15.30 on a 14.99-15.32 range, historically calm, though that is a Friday cash close rather than a live reading. Delayed latest-session context shows the same internal split that argues for a mixed rather than trending characterisation: semiconductors were broadly higher, led by Micron, AMD and Intel, while megacaps were mostly lower on a mean of about -1.2% with Tesla and Apple the weakest, and application software lagged. The concentrated risk in this window is therefore no longer the restart but the 13:30Z cash reopen, when the weekend tanker exchange and Friday's hawkish payrolls price together at full depth for the first time. That hour and the one following are mapped to WATCH; every other slot stays in the EA_ON band. All post-cutoff structure is framed conditionally, and only the restart itself, the current quotes and the already-published reporting cited here are stated as fact.

lookbackSummary: All twenty-four of the last twenty-four hourly Claude assessments are available. The window was uniformly green with EA_ON throughout and Tail confined to a 5-10% band, so no slot approached the block threshold. Stress ran at 54-57% through the Asian and European sessions, stepped up to 61-64% across the US afternoon as crude extended and holiday liquidity thinned, and held at 62-63% from the 17:00Z halt to the 21:00Z slot. Confidence fell from 86% to 75% over the stretch as live price evidence disappeared with the halt, and recovers this hour now that the restart is observable. Dominant mode was normal apart from the 14:00Z, 16:00Z, 17:00Z and 19:00Z slots, which were mixed while the energy-versus-equity divergence widened.
outlookSummary: The prior window's single mapped danger window has resolved benignly: futures restarted at 22:00Z without a gap and with sub-0.2% moves in both NQ and ES, so the opening slot carries observed rather than hypothetical structure and Tail sits near its floor. Path risk decays through the Asian session, rises modestly at the 07:00Z European cash open, which is the first full-depth non-US repricing of the weekend escalation, and peaks at the 13:30Z US cash reopen. That reopen is the one concentrated risk of the window because the weekend tanker exchange and Friday's 162,000-payroll surprise price together at full depth for the first time; the 13:00Z and 14:00Z slots alone map to WATCH, and the mapped danger window is 13:30Z-14:30Z. Tail is then projected to decay through the US afternoon on the assumption that price discovery is orderly and retracements appear, with a modest nudge into the power hour for closing-auction imbalance on the first session after a long weekend. Stress stays elevated but easing throughout because the crude supply premium is unresolved while the SPR drawdown and weaker Chinese demand cap it. NFIB at 10:00Z, weekly ADP at 12:15Z, NY Fed inflation expectations at 15:00Z, the 3-year auction at 17:00Z and consumer credit at 19:00Z are the scheduled checkpoints inside the window, with PPI and claims on Thursday and CPI on Friday as the week's principal events. All post-cutoff price structure is framed conditionally.
